description_expanded: ABOUT THE WAY OF WATER: "The Way of Water" is a newly built vacation home located on the Northside of 30A's Inlet Beach, Florida. This vacay hideaway features brand new furnishings throughout each space with a fully equipped kitchen, indoor/outdoor dining, sleeper sofa in the living room, and an entire 3rd-floor family suite. In addition to providing a restful vacation experience for up to 10 guests, this private residence is also dog friendly! Your reservation also comes with complimentary bicycle cruisers for nearby exploration into the local shops and restaurants of 30Avenue. Once you reach the quiet 30A neighborhood of "The Ivy", you'll find The Way of Water tucked away on the outer most street, just next to the tree line. The outdoor sitting area for 2, leads straight to the front door and into the main living, kitchen, and dining area on the ground floor. Inside furnishings comfortably host 10 guests to cook, dine, and relax. Whether you're the kind of guest who's tuning into the big game on Saturday or the one who brought all the family's favorite recipes to cook, you will all be together making lifelong memories! The second floor leads up to the first walkout balcony, furnished with an outdoor dining table. Just before making your way outside to greet the Sunrise, there is a quaint coffee station waiting to brew your first cup! A designated desk/workplace has also been set up just before you reach the balcony. Two king suites sit just down the hall. One having its own entrance to the large open balcony overlooking the neighborhood while the other has a quaint view of the backyard, each have private ensuites. Most of the space on the third floor is dedicated to recreation and entertainment! A large smart tv hangs on the wall, accompanied by kids movie chairs, family board games & puzzles. French doors open to an additional walkout balcony overlooking the neighborhood, creating a fun open-air space to hang out together as a family! There is a twin over twin bunk bed here as well, followed by a queen bedroom just off of the recreational space. ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood located along Florida's scenic Highway 30A. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal getaway for visitors seeking a more laid-back vacation experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. When you stay in Inlet Beach you are never far from the beach, or a magnificent view. To explore 30A, take a bike ride to Rosemary Beach to enjoy the farmers market, discover the new 30A Avenue shops, taste the fine local cuisine, and visit local businesses along 30A. Visitors can also explore the neighboring beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options. For additional shopping and adventure, take a family drive to Pier Park in Panama City Beach or travel to the Sandestin Outlet shops. Inlet Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. With its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of recreational opportunities, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Inlet Beach Regional Public Beach Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Short walk or bike ride to the beach * Community Pool * 2 complimentary bikes PARKING: * Free Parking for up to 2 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 25 years or older * A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed, with a weight limit of 50 lbs. per dog. A non-refundable $250 pet fee applies per pet. The fee is to be charged after reservation confirmation. * Smoking is not permitted DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties, and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.
